title: CrmPersistSegmentOutput
description: `{ success:true, segment }` or the fail-closed `{ success:false, errors }` — never a write of an invalid draft. A refusal at the surface (tenant guard, link validation, cap, tombstone) is a TYPED node failure, never a success with an empty entity.

segment.description: The segment row as the surface projects it (host bookkeeping columns `tenantId`/`orgId`/`createdBy`/`updatedBy` stripped).

errors.description: Present with `success:false` — the surface RE-VALIDATED closed-world and refused WITHOUT writing.
